{{Quote|You hunger for power of the sort you imagine is to be found on Korriban, Dromund Kaas, Zigoola. Then let me tell you what you'll encounter in those reliquaries: Jedi, treasure hunters, and legends.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Zigoola''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas" /> and a potent [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|The Force]]<ref name="F&D CR" /> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], near the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]].<ref name="Atlas" /> A [[Zigoola Sith temple|Sith Temple]] was located on the barren world, and was used by the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] for hoarding [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. The planet did not appear in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and its location was kept secret by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission to Zigoola|traveled]] to Zigoola and destroyed the Sith Temple, but were unable to recover any of its artifacts for further study. Zigoola's strength with the dark side of the Force severely affected Obi-Wan Kenobi when he and Bail Organa were on it. They were rescued by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], who were sent after Kenobi telepathically contacted the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for help.<ref name="Wild Space" />
